يحتقبوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِبُوا (yaḥtaqibū) /jaħ.ta.qi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# يُحْتَقَبُوا (yuḥtaqabū) /juħ.ta.qa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
